method: Temporary debug instrumentation (fprintf+fflush before every field dereference, later reverted -- not part of the final patch) added directly inside ggml_vk_tensor_subbuffer (third_party/llama.cpp/ggml/src/ggml-vulkan/ggml-vulkan.cpp) and inside llama_kv_cache::cpy_v/get_v (llama-kv-cache.cpp), to trace exactly which tensor triggers the failure and whether llama-kv-cache.cpp's own view-construction code is ever called with a stale layers[ikv].v after a second relocation.

exact_failing_tensor.name: cache_v_l4 (view)
exact_failing_tensor.op: 42 (GGML_OP_SET_ROWS -- the cpy_v() write path storing the current token's V into cache)
exact_failing_tensor.view_src: 0x5a570a98d650 (the base V tensor this view was built from at graph-construction time)

buffer_after_relocation_2_and_free_pre_f.buffer_context_ptr: 0x5a570000003d -- implausibly small/pattern-like, not a real heap pointer
buffer_after_relocation_2_and_free_pre_f.buffer_size: 2 -- implausibly small for a real KV buffer (should be hundreds of KB)
buffer_after_relocation_2_and_free_pre_f.interpretation: tensor->buffer points to a dangling/freed ggml_backend_buffer struct whose memory has been reused; the vtable call succeeds (still valid function pointer) but the ->context/->size fields read garbage from whatever now occupies that memory -- classic use-after-free signature

exact_failing_tensor.crash_point: dereferencing (ggml_backend_vk_buffer_context *)tensor->buffer->context immediately after this, to read ->dev_buffer

backward_trace.does_it_derive_from_the_old_kv_backing: Yes, indirectly -- it is a node from the PREVIOUS decode's graph (built while layer 4 was still GPU-resident, before relocation #2), not from a fresh graph build for the current decode. See scheduler_lifetime.json for why this old graph gets executed again.
backward_trace.evidence: Instrumented cpy_v/get_v to log every call with il==4: 24 total calls logged across the whole repro sequence (prompt decode, relocation #1's follow-up decode), and ZERO further calls for the crashing 'third sentence' decode. This proves llama-graph.cpp never rebuilt the graph for that decode at all -- see raw_cpy_get_v_trace.txt.
